summary: Recorded the executed follow-up receipt 0b9c22ae5fb043588aa7efa3ad009b25 (experiment 40ab66a5c5c847619ae2ff68b85641e7-experiment, twelve tests passed) and closed both questions it was launched for. The healthy NoSnapshot control settles the first: on a cluster that never drifted (accepted 6 / decided 6, readable six-element decided log, events 238-240) the public snapshot(Some(6), true) panicked with the compacted index unchanged at 0 (event 241), matching the drifted witness (2cb2a3f1e43b4942b5bb3f42bad11091 event 129), so the abort follows from the entry type and the call rather than from the drift, and knowledge 40ab66a5c5c847619ae2ff68b85641e7-knowledge-0 was revised accordingly. The snapshot-capable probe reaches the below-compacted state: after the drift, the leader change and a local snapshot inside the drifted decided index (compacted 8, snapshot holding zero ids, event 155), the re-synchronization of the replica whose reported accepted index lay below the compacted index raised no panic (event 162) but installed that complete snapshot and no suffix, leaving the replica at accepted 10 / decided 10 with a decided-log read of two entries instead of six (event 161) and moving the leader's decided index to 10 (events 159-162), which is now a new knowledge entry and a sixth consequence class in the parent drift account. Both accounts were written: the parent question-level account (conclusion violated, defect asserted, experiment 40ab66a5c5c847619ae2ff68b85641e7-experiment, ten receipts, controls preserved) and an account for the new question 40ab66a5c5c847619ae2ff68b85641e7-question-1; the latter is question-level (conclusion explained, defect asserted) because a violated account requires an experiment belonging to that same investigation, which does not exist yet. Both discriminators were rewritten to what remains: whether a forwarded Compaction::Snapshot message can reach a NoSnapshot instance from a peer, whether a trim over-compaction followed by such a re-synchronization behaves the same, and whether a non-empty remainder would be handed over instead of an empty snapshot. Incomplete: those peer-side and trim-side variants and the trim child's gap b26c13954e184cd2b9fdfda975aff136-gap-4.
